Spacecraft ATISE (Auroral Thermosphere Ionosphere Spectrometer Experiment, Zegrensat )
Spacecraft type CubeSat
Units or mass 12U
Status not launched, expected in 2026
Launcher not launched
Organisation CSUG-IPAG (Univ. Grenoble Alpes)
Institution University
Entity Academic / Education
Headquarters France
Partners Moscow State University (SINP)
Oneliner

Auroral visible spectrometry and imaging at the limb.

Description

Auroral visible spectrometry and imaging at the limb. 6 lines of sight for the spectrometer. Two scientific instruments: a spectrometer and an imager. Space weather, especially the aurora viewing. Measure the spectra of terrestrial auroras to better understand the light emission process

Notes

Co-Pis: Mathieu Barthelemy (CSUG-IPAG), Vladimir Kalegaev (SINP, MSU)
